title: The CI release workflow has the same ungated wrapper publish that QCLI-299 fixed locally
description:
Found while fixing QCLI-299, in a file its acceptance criteria do not name, so it is filed rather than folded in.

QCLI-299 gates the WRAPPER publish on a consumer-side read of all six platform packages, but only in scripts/publish-release.mjs. The CI path has the identical defect: .github/workflows/release.yml publishes the six platform packages in a shell loop and then publishes @opum-ai/quest immediately after, with nothing between them but the loop ending. The retry step that follows is the same confirmation-not-gate shape QCLI-299 removed from the local script -- it runs AFTER the wrapper is already on the registry.

Not urgent, and the reason is worth stating rather than assuming: this path did not publish 0.7.0. Trusted publishing is still broken (QCLI-271, an immutable-subject-claim mismatch in the OIDC exchange), so releases are going out through the local script, which is the path that now has the gate. The day CI publishing is restored is the day this defect becomes live again, and that is exactly when nobody will be looking at it.

The fix is not a copy of the script: CI runs the loop in shell, so the gate belongs as a step between the platform loop and the wrapper publish, invoking the same waitForConsumerVisibility used locally rather than reimplementing the read.

acceptanceCriteria.text: release.yml does not publish @opum-ai/quest until a consumer-side read confirms all six platform packages resolve, using scripts/qualification/registry-visibility.mjs rather than a second implementation of the same read
A failed gate fails the job with the per-package state printed, and leaves the wrapper unpublished -- verified by a dry-run or fixture, not by reasoning about the YAML
The post-publish retry step stays, and its message no longer claims a timeout is lag rather than a failed release
The relationship to QCLI-271 is recorded: if trusted publishing is restored before this lands, that restoration is what makes this defect live
